sloka: सन्त्यन्याः प्रमदास्तुभ्यं रूपेणाभ्यधिकास्ततः ।अनङ्गवशमापन्नस्त्वं तु मोहान्न बुध्यसे ।। ६.११४.२७ ।।
transliteration: santyanyāḥ pramadāstubhyaṁ rūpeṇābhyadhikāstataḥ ।anaṅgavaśamāpannastvaṁ tu mohānna budhyase ।। 6.114.27 ।।

translations.english: "When time comes surely one who does sinful action will reap the result. There is no doubt that the doer of a terrible action will be destroyed."
